Enter the IP address or host name shown in your VPS control panel.
SSH usually uses port 22. Change it if your provider gave you a different SSH port.
Use the login name for your server. Your VPS provider usually lists it next to the access details.
Choose password if you sign in with a password. Choose SSH key if you have a private key file for this server.
Update the address or sign-in details for this server.
Fill this in only if you have set up a secure web address for the Horizon agent. Leave it empty to connect through SSH.
Some SSH keys are protected by a separate password. Enter the password you set for the key, or leave this blank if it has none.
